### Recommendations for correct storage

The sample should be stored in a dust-free and dry environment avoiding contamination and contact with moisture.

### Expiration of certification

The date of expiry of certification is 30<sup>th</sup> April 2026. Before this date a new certificate will be prepared with a new date of expiry.

### Safety guidelines

1. First aid measures
In case of contamination of the eyes by dust, rinse thoroughly with water with the eyelids held open. If product is swallowed, induce vomiting and consult a physician.
2. Handling
Avoid formation and deposition of dust. Ensure adequate ventilation and, if necessary, exhaust ventilation when handling or transferring the product. To avoid injuries do not bring the material into contact with your skin.
3. Exposure restriction and personal protection
Hand protection: protective gloves
Eye protection: safety goggles
4. Disposal considerations
Unused material: reuse if possible.
Or: may be disposed of in controlled landfills provided local regulations are respected.

### References

Guadagnino, E., Sundberg, P., O. Corumluoglu “A collaborative study on the determination of hexavalent chromium in container glasses“, in: Glass Technol., 42 (2001) 148-152
